text: Avnet Inc. trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and has dispersed institutional ownership: its disclosed 5%+ holders are The Vanguard Group (12.61%), BlackRock (9.5%), Pzena Investment Management (8.5%) and Dimensional Fund Advisors (6.9%), with no state shareholder identified.
